original_prompt: Create an Ansible playbook that installs the OpenTelemetry Collector (binary or yum/apt repository), configures it to receive OTLP on port 4317 and export to a remote endpoint, and starts it as a systemd service.
user_message_sent:
Target IaC language: Ansible playbook (YAML)

Task: Create an Ansible playbook that installs the OpenTelemetry Collector (binary or yum/apt repository), configures it to receive OTLP on port 4317 and export to a remote endpoint, and starts it as a systemd service.

Output only the Ansible playbook (YAML) code, no commentary or markdown fences.
raw_response:
---
- name: Install and configure OpenTelemetry Collector
  hosts: all
  become: true
  vars:
    otelcol_version: "0.110.0"
    otelcol_user: otelcol
    otelcol_group: otelcol
    otelcol_config_dir: /etc/otelcol
    otelcol_install_dir: /usr/local/bin
    otelcol_data_dir: /var/lib/otelcol
    otelcol_log_dir: /var/log/otelcol
    otelcol_otlp_grpc_port: 4317
    otelcol_otlp_http_port: 4318
    otelcol_remote_endpoint: "https://otel-gateway.example.com:4317"
    otelcol_remote_headers:
      authorization: "Bearer REPLACE_WITH_TOKEN"
    otelcol_remote_tls_insecure: false
    otelcol_arch_map:
      x86_64: amd64
      aarch64: arm64
      armv7l: armhf

  pre_tasks:
    - name: Assert supported OS family
      ansible.builtin.assert:
        that:
          - ansible_os_family in ['Debian', 'RedHat']
        fail_msg: "Unsupported OS family: {{ ansible_os_family }}"

    - name: Set architecture fact
      ansible.builtin.set_fact:
        otelcol_arch: "{{ otelcol_arch_map[ansible_architecture] | default('amd64') }}"

  tasks:
    - name: Ensure required packages are installed (Debian)
      ansible.builtin.apt:
        name:
          - ca-certificates
          - curl
          - tar
        state: present
        update_cache: true
      when: ansible_os_family == 'Debian'

    - name: Ensure required packages are installed (RedHat)
      ansible.builtin.yum:
        name:
          - ca-certificates
          - curl
          - tar
        state: present
      when: ansible_os_family == 'RedHat'

    - name: Create otelcol group
      ansible.builtin.group:
        name: "{{ otelcol_group }}"
        system: true
        state: present

    - name: Create otelcol system user
      ansible.builtin.user:
        name: "{{ otelcol_user }}"
        group: "{{ otelcol_group }}"
        system: true
        shell: /usr/sbin/nologin
        home: "{{ otelcol_data_dir }}"
        create_home: false
        state: present

    - name: Create otelcol directories
      ansible.builtin.file:
        path: "{{ item.path }}"
        state: directory
        owner: "{{ item.owner | default(otelcol_user) }}"
        group: "{{ item.group | default(otelcol_group) }}"
        mode: "{{ item.mode | default('0750') }}"
      loop:
        - { path: "{{ otelcol_config_dir }}", owner: root, group: "{{ otelcol_group }}", mode: '0750' }
        - { path: "{{ otelcol_data_dir }}", mode: '0750' }
        - { path: "{{ otelcol_log_dir }}", mode: '0750' }

    - name: Check current otelcol binary version
      ansible.builtin.command: "{{ otelcol_install_dir }}/otelcol --version"
      register: otelcol_current_version
      changed_when: false
      failed_when: false

    - name: Download OpenTelemetry Collector tarball
      ansible.builtin.get_url:
        url: "https://github.com/open-telemetry/opentelemetry-collector-releases/releases/download/v{{ otelcol_version }}/otelcol_{{ otelcol_version }}_linux_{{ otelcol_arch }}.tar.gz"
        dest: "/tmp/otelcol_{{ otelcol_version }}_linux_{{ otelcol_arch }}.tar.gz"
        mode: '0644'
        force: false
      when: otelcol_version not in otelcol_current_version.stdout | default('')
      register: otelcol_download

    - name: Extract OpenTelemetry Collector
      ansible.builtin.unarchive:
        src: "/tmp/otelcol_{{ otelcol_version }}_linux_{{ otelcol_arch }}.tar.gz"
        dest: "{{ otelcol_install_dir }}"
        remote_src: true
        include:
          - otelcol
        owner: root
        group: root
        mode: '0755'
      when: otelcol_download is changed
      notify: Restart otelcol

    - name: Grant capability to bind privileged ports (defensive)
      community.general.capabilities:
        path: "{{ otelcol_install_dir }}/otelcol"
        capability: cap_net_bind_service=+ep
        state: present
      failed_when: false

    - name: Deploy OpenTelemetry Collector configuration
      ansible.builtin.copy:
        dest: "{{ otelcol_config_dir }}/config.yaml"
        owner: root
        group: "{{ otelcol_group }}"
        mode: '0640'
        content: |
          receivers:
            otlp:
              protocols:
                grpc:
                  endpoint: 0.0.0.0:{{ otelcol_otlp_grpc_port }}
                http:
                  endpoint: 0.0.0.0:{{ otelcol_otlp_http_port }}

          processors:
            batch:
              send_batch_size: 8192
              timeout: 5s
            memory_limiter:
              check_interval: 1s
              limit_percentage: 80
              spike_limit_percentage: 25

          exporters:
            otlp:
              endpoint: {{ otelcol_remote_endpoint }}
              headers:
          {% for k, v in otelcol_remote_headers.items() %}
                {{ k }}: "{{ v }}"
          {% endfor %}
              tls:
                insecure: {{ otelcol_remote_tls_insecure | lower }}
              sending_queue:
                enabled: true
                num_consumers:
